description: Unit frame (Geraeterahmen): how the GR view recognises parts, and the length parameter of each profile kind
notes: How the GR view recognises parts by file name (regular expressions, first match wins). Add lines for product lines that name parts differently. kind: corner, joint, frameProfile, divider, panel, base, damper, stub. lengthParameters: the parameter that holds the length of each profile kind (used to write new profile lengths into Inventor).
cornerNotes: Outer size = profile + 2 x the corner's perSide (its 130 mm leg sits inside the profile). cornerAdd is used when no corner type matches.

panels.notes: Panel = seat-to-seat - 2 x clearance; seat-to-seat = clear space between the profiles + 2 x seatDepth. W = the shorter side. height = panel height (depth in the seat). A side over maxSize needs a divider. An opening (seat to seat) below oneInnerPanelBelow gets the 1T master, otherwise 2T.

faceNamesNotes: Faces each part must have named (iLogic Assign Name) so the app can mate it. panelAu = the -Au tray part of a panel. Checked by Files > Check named faces.
